1.def: To be — «bo'lmoq» fe'li. O'zbekchada «Men talabaman», «U xursand» deganda fe'l ko'rinmaydi, ingliz tilida esa am / is / are albatta aytiladi. U egani uning kimligi, holati yoki qayerdaligi bilan bog'laydi.
forms: I → am ; he, she, it → is ; we, you, they → are
1.tip: I yolg'iz — am. Bitta odam yoki narsa — is. Ko'pchilik (va you) — are.
rules: Gapda boshqa fe'l bo'lmasa, am / is / are shart.
Kasbdan oldin a / an qo'yiladi: She is a teacher.
Yoshni have bilan emas, be bilan aytamiz: I am ten.
Savolda am / is / are egadan oldinga chiqadi.

2.def: Present Simple — odat, doimiy holat va umumiy haqiqatni bildiradi: har kuni, odatda, doim bo'ladigan ishlar. Eng muhim narsa: he, she, it bo'lsa fe'lga -s qo'shiladi.
uses: The sun rises in the east.
2.tip: He, she, it — «S» ni unutma: bitta uchinchi shaxs bo'lsa, fe'l oxirida -s.
rules: always, usually, often asosiy fe'ldan oldin turadi: I often walk.
be fe'lidan keyin turadi: He is always late.
go → goes, do → does.
play → plays (unli + y o'zgarmaydi).

3.def: Present Simple'da savol va inkor yordamchi fe'l do / does bilan yasaladi. does allaqachon -s ni o'ziga oladi, shuning uchun asosiy fe'l o'zining oddiy shaklida qoladi.
forms: What time do you get up?
3.tip: does keldimi — fe'ldagi -s ketadi: He works → Does he work?
rules: don't / doesn't / does dan keyin fe'l oddiy shaklda.
be fe'li bilan do ishlatilmaydi: Are you tired?
Qisqa javobda do / does takrorlanadi.
ex: Do your friends live near here?

4.def: Present Continuous — AYNAN HOZIR bo'layotgan yoki shu kunlarda davom etayotgan, vaqtinchalik ishni bildiradi. Ikki qismdan iborat: am / is / are va fe'l-ing.
uses: She is staying with us this week.
forms: S + am / is / are + not + V-ing
Wh-word + am / is / are + S + V-ing?
4.tip: Ko'z oldingizda sodir bo'lyaptimi? Demak be + -ing.
rules: write → writing (oxirgi e tushadi).
sit → sitting, run → running (undosh ikkilanadi).
lie → lying.
know, like, want kabi holat fe'llari odatda Continuous bo'lmaydi.

5.def: Ikkalasi ham hozirgi zamon, lekin farqi katta: Present Simple — ODATDA bo'ladigan ish, Present Continuous — HOZIR bo'layotgan ish.
uses: This week she is working at home.
5.tip: «Odatda» desa bo'lsa — Simple. «Hozir» desa bo'lsa — Continuous.
rules: What do you do? — kasbing nima?
What are you doing? — hozir nima qilyapsan?
Holat fe'llari (know, like, love, want, need) Simple'da ishlatiladi.
ex: She usually wears jeans, but today she is wearing a dress.
U odatda jinsi kiyadi, bugun esa ko'ylakda.
I speak Uzbek. Right now I am speaking English.
Men o'zbekcha gapiraman. Hozir inglizcha gapiryapman.
It rains a lot here, but it isn't raining now.
Bu yerda yomg'ir ko'p yog'adi, hozir esa yog'mayapti.
err: I am going to school every day.
I go to school every day.
Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.

6.def: have va have got — «bor», «ega bo'lmoq». Ma'nosi bir xil: I have a car = I've got a car. have got ko'proq og'zaki britancha nutqda ishlatiladi.
6.tip: got bor — have o'zi yordamchi (Have you got?). got yo'q — do yordamga keladi (Do you have?).
rules: have breakfast, have a shower kabi iboralarda got ishlatilmaydi.
O'tgan zamonda had (got odatda qo'shilmaydi).
Qisqa javob: Yes, I have. / Yes, I do.
err: Do you have got a pen?

7.def: was / were — to be fe'lining o'tgan zamoni: «edi», «bo'lgan». O'tmishda kimdir qayerda bo'lgani yoki qanday holatda bo'lganini aytadi.
forms: I, he, she, it → was ; we, you, they → were
He was happy and they were happy too.
7.tip: am va is o'tmishda — was. are o'tmishda — were.
rules: Savolda was / were oldinga chiqadi.
did ishlatilmaydi: Were you there?
born doim was / were bilan: I was born.

8.def: Past Simple — o'tmishda bo'lib TUGAGAN ish. To'g'ri (regular) fe'llarning o'tgan shakli -ed qo'shib yasaladi va barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil bo'ladi.
uses: He opened the door and walked in.
We lived there for two years.
8.tip: Darak gapda shaxsning farqi yo'q: I worked, he worked, they worked.
rules: -ed talaffuzi: /t/ (worked), /d/ (played), /ɪd/ (wanted).
t yoki d dan keyin -ed alohida bo'g'in bo'ladi.
ago vaqtdan keyin keladi: three days ago.
ex: I called my friend last night.
She visited London two years ago.
U ikki yil oldin Londonga borgan.

9.def: Noto'g'ri (irregular) fe'llar -ed olmaydi: ularning o'tgan shakli (V2) o'ziga xos bo'ladi va yodlanadi. Shakl barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil.
uses: We saw a bear and ran away.
forms: come → came ; give → gave ; write → wrote ; get → got
go → went ; buy → bought ; make → made
have → had ; see → saw ; eat → ate ; take → took
put → put ; cut → cut ; read → read
I put it on the table.
9.tip: Fe'lni uchlik qilib yodlang: go — went — gone.
rules: read yozilishi o'zgarmaydi, o'tgan zamonda /red/ o'qiladi.
Ikki marta o'tgan shakl qo'yilmaydi (wented emas).
Inkor va savolda V2 emas, V1 ishlatiladi.

10.def: Past Simple'da savol va inkor did bilan yasaladi. did o'tgan zamonni o'zi ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun asosiy fe'l oddiy shaklga (V1) qaytadi.
forms: Yes, S + did. ; No, S + didn't.
10.tip: did keldimi — fe'l «yosharadi»: went → go, saw → see.
rules: did hamma shaxs uchun bir xil.
was / were bilan did ishlatilmaydi.
Who ega bo'lsa did kerak emas: Who called you?
ex: I didn't go to work yesterday.

11.def: be going to — kelajakdagi REJA va NIYAT («-moqchiman»), shuningdek hozirgi belgiga qarab «hozir shunday bo'ladi» degan taxmin.
uses: I'm going to learn to drive.
Look at the sky. It's going to rain.
What are you going to do tonight?
forms: S + am / is / are + going to + V1
S + am / is / are + not + going to + V1
Am / Is / Are + S + going to + V1?
Wh-word + am / is / are + S + going to + V1?
Where are you going to stay?
11.tip: Qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan bo'lsa — going to.
rules: to dan keyin fe'l oddiy shaklda.
be fe'li shaxsga moslashadi.
Og'zaki nutqda «gonna» eshitiladi, lekin yozma ishda going to yozing.
ex: She is going to be a doctor.
Be careful! You're going to fall.
We aren't going to buy it.

12.def: can — qobiliyat, imkon va ruxsat («qila olaman», «mumkinmi»). could — can ning o'tgan zamoni, shuningdek muloyimroq iltimos.
uses: I could read when I was five.
12.tip: can hech qachon o'zgarmaydi: -s ham, to ham olmaydi.
rules: can dan keyin to yo'q.
he / she / it bilan ham can (cans emas).
Savolda can egadan oldin turadi, do kerak emas.
cannot bitta so'z qilib yoziladi.
ex: My brother can speak three languages.

13.def: would like — «xohlardim», «istardim». want ga qaraganda ancha muloyim, shuning uchun do'kon, kafe va rasmiy suhbatda ishlatiladi.
uses: I'd like a cup of tea.
forms: We would like a table for two.
I wouldn't like to live there.
Would you like + ot / to + V1?
Would you like to join us?
13.tip: like — yoqtiraman (umuman). would like — hozir xohlayman.
rules: would like dan keyin fe'l kelsa, to qo'yiladi.
would barcha shaxslarda bir xil.
Taklifga javob: Yes, please. yoki Yes, I'd love to.
ex: I'd like to book a room.
What would you like to drink?
I like coffee, but now I'd like some water.
Qahvani yoqtiraman, lekin hozir suv ichgim kelyapti.
err: I would like to a coffee.

14.def: Ingliz tilida savolda so'z tartibi o'zgaradi: yordamchi fe'l egadan OLDIN keladi. O'zbekchadagidek faqat ohang bilan savol berish yetarli emas.
forms: How old / How much / How often …?
14.tip: QASV tartibi: Question word → Auxiliary (yordamchi) → Subject (ega) → Verb (fe'l).
rules: Yordamchi fe'llar: do, does, did, am, is, are, was, were, can, will.
Gapda be yoki can bo'lmasa, do / does / did qo'shiladi.
Predlog odatda oxirida qoladi: Who are you waiting for?
ex: What time does the film start?

15.def: who (kim) va what (nima) ikki xil savol beradi. Agar so'roq so'zning O'ZI EGA bo'lsa, do / does / did ishlatilmaydi. Agar to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, odatdagi savol tartibi kerak.
forms: Who / What + do / does / did + S + V1?
signals: Who did you call? → I called Anvar.
15.tip: Javobda so'ralgan so'z gap boshida tursa — do kerak emas.
rules: Ega haqidagi savolda fe'l odatda birlikda: Who knows?
who odamlar, what narsalar haqida.
What happened? — doim did'siz.
ex: What do you do on Sundays?

16.def: Inglizlar savolga shunchaki «yes» yoki «no» demaydi: yordamchi fe'lni qaytarib, qisqa to'liq javob beradi. Savol qaysi yordamchi fe'l bilan boshlansa, javobda ham o'sha ishlatiladi.
uses: Do you like tea? Yes, I do.
Is he busy? No, he isn't.
Can you swim? Yes, I can.
forms: Yes, S + did. ; No, S + didn't.
16.tip: Savolning birinchi so'zi — javobning oxirgi so'zi.
rules: Ijobiy qisqa javobda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi: Yes, I am (Yes, I'm emas).
Inkor javobda qisqartma mumkin: No, I'm not.
Ismlar olmoshga almashadi: Is Aziz here? Yes, he is.
ex: Are you a student? Yes, I am.
Does your sister work? No, she doesn't.
Did you enjoy the party? Yes, we did.
err: Do you like it? Yes, I like.
Is he here? Yes, he does.

17.def: Inglizchada otlar ikki turga bo'linadi: SANALADIGAN (bitta, ikkita deb sanaladi: apple, book) va SANALMAYDIGAN (modda yoki umumiy narsa: water, bread, money).
uses: I have one apple and two bananas.
There is some water in the bottle.
forms: a + idish yoki bo'lak + of + ot
17.tip: Bo'laklab yoki to'kib o'lchasangiz — sanalmaydi. Barmoq bilan sanasangiz — sanaladi.
rules: Sanalmaydigan ot bilan fe'l birlikda: The bread is fresh.
money sanalmaydi, coins va banknotes sanaladi.
Noto'g'ri ko'plik: man → men, child → children, tooth → teeth.
ex: I need a piece of paper.
The money is on the table.
There are two children in the room.

18.def: a va an — «bitta», «bir» ma'nosidagi noaniq artikl. Faqat birlikdagi sanaladigan ot oldidan keladi. Qaysi biri kelishi keyingi so'zning birinchi TOVUSHIGA bog'liq.
forms: an old house, a nice egg
rules: Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan ot a / an olmaydi.
Artikl sifatdan oldin turadi.
Sifat bo'lsa, tanlov sifatning tovushiga qaraydi.
ex: She eats an orange every day.
U har kuni bitta apelsin yeydi.

19.def: the — aniq artikl: «o'sha», «ma'lum bo'lgan». Gapiruvchi ham, tinglovchi ham qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotganini bilsa ishlatiladi.
uses: I saw a dog. The dog was big.
forms: the car, the cars, the water
I bought a shirt. The shirt is blue.
19.tip: «Qaysi biri?» degan savolga ikkalamiz ham javob bilsak — the.
rules: Umumiy ma'noda the qo'yilmaydi: I like dogs.
Shahar va ko'pchilik mamlakat oldidan the yo'q.
Ovqat vaqti va sport oldidan the yo'q: have lunch, play football.
ex: The children are in the garden.
I listen to music in the evening.

20.def: some va any — «biroz», «bir nechta», «birorta». Asosiy farq gap turida: some darak gapda, any inkor va savolda ishlatiladi.
20.tip: Plus — some. Minus va so'roq — any.
rules: Birlikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan a / an ishlating.
Savoldan «ha» javobini kutsangiz (taklif) — some.
I have no money = I don't have any money.

21.def: much, many va a lot of — «ko'p». many sanaladigan otlar bilan, much sanalmaydiganlar bilan, a lot of esa ikkalasi bilan ham ishlaydi.
uses: How many books do you have?
She has a lot of friends.
forms: a lot of cars, a lot of money
signals: How much is it? — narxi qancha
21.tip: Sanay olsang — many. Sanay olmasang — much.
rules: much va many ko'proq inkor va savolda, darakda a lot of tabiiyroq.
a lot (of siz) gap oxirida: I read a lot.
people ko'plik: many people.
ex: I drink a lot of water.

22.def: there is / there are — «…da …bor». Gapni narsadan emas, uning BORLIGIDAN boshlaymiz: avval there, keyin fe'l, keyin narsa va joy.
uses: There is a park near my house.
forms: There is a cat on the chair.
22.tip: Fe'l keyingi otga qaraydi: bitta bo'lsa is, ko'p bo'lsa are.
rules: Sanalmaydigan ot bilan There is.
Ro'yxatda birinchi so'z birlik bo'lsa is: There is a pen and two books.
it is bilan adashtirmang: it ma'lum narsaga ishora qiladi.
ex: There is some milk in the fridge.
There are many students in the hall.
Is there a bus stop near here?
err: In my room is a TV.
There is a TV in my room.
Have a park in my city.
There is a park in my city.

23.def: Egalik so'zlari ikki xil: my, your… — OTDAN OLDIN keladi; mine, yours… — otning o'rnini bosib, YOLG'IZ turadi.
forms: my / your / his / her / its / our / their + ot
mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs
Whose + ot + is / are + this / these?
23.tip: Keyin ot bormi? Bor — my. Yo'q — mine.
rules: mine, yours dan keyin ot kelmaydi.
its (uniki) apostrofsiz; it's = it is.
his ikkala holatda ham bir xil.
ex: My house is small, but theirs is big.
Mening uyim kichik, ularniki esa katta.
The dog is eating its food.

24.def: Vaqt predloglari: at — ANIQ NUQTA (soat), on — KUN va sana, in — UZUNROQ davr (oy, yil, fasl).
forms: at + soat / night / noon / the weekend
in the morning / afternoon / evening ; at night
24.tip: Kichikdan kattaga: at (soat) → on (kun) → in (oy va yil).
rules: next, last, this, every oldidan predlog yo'q: next Monday.
today, tomorrow, yesterday predlogsiz.
Kun nomi aniqlasa on: on Friday evening.

25.def: Joy predloglari: at — NUQTA yoki joyning vazifasi, on — SIRT ustida, in — biror narsaning ICHIDA.
uses: Wait for me at the bus stop.
The book is on the table.
forms: at the door, at a party
on the wall, on the second floor
The cat is under the bed.
25.tip: Nuqta — at. Sirt — on. Hajm (ichi bor) — in.
rules: at home — the qo'yilmaydi.
Avtobus va poyezdda on, mashina va taksida in.
Rasmda: in the picture; devorda: on the wall.
ex: My keys are in my pocket.
There is a clock on the wall.
err: The picture is in the wall.
The picture is on the wall.
